jia: Quick thread — ran FP8 enablement sweep across H100 and L40S. H100 looks stable; L40S intermittently produces +inf/NaN after ~200 tokens when using transformer engine kernel `te_fp8_v2`. Also seeing KV-cache eviction spikes and tail latency jumps. Using kv_cache=enabled, batching=auto, quant_calib=128steps per-layer.

alex: Are the NaNs only during KV cache warmup or also on cold starts?

jia: Mostly during warmup and on requests that reuse prefixes. Cold-start runs behave. Repro locally with seed 42, command I used:
```
python run_infer.py --model rdlm-small --seq 1024 --fp8 --kernel te_fp8_v2 --seed 42 --kv-cache
```

samir: Can you upload the flamegraph/profile? My hunch: on L40S the GEMM kernel selection is falling back mid-sequence (precision/overflow detection) and we get unstable accumulators. Did you try INT8 or the te_fp8_v1 kernel?

jia: Uploaded perf summary to the perf bucket (link in thread). FP8 -> policy fallback to INT8 gives stability but quality regresses noticeably. Perf: H100 FP8 ~2.6x vs FP16; L40S FP8 only ~1.4x and shows instability. Profile shows unexpected time in kv_eviction + serializer paths when batch sizes vary.

priya: Two quick hypotheses:
1) Batching heuristic may be grouping very long and short sequences together causing KV thrash and eviction churn — try capping `max_batch_tokens` and prefer length-aware bucketing.
2) Calibration: 128-step global per-layer clipping might be overfitting L40S activation ranges. Try per-layer 64-step with asymmetric clipping + max-abs clipping for activations.

jia: Good suggestions. I'll run a sweep: (a) force kernel_selector hint -> prefer `te_fp8_v1` on L40S, (b) cap batch tokens to 64 and enable length-buckets, (c) per-layer 64-step calib. Will canary the change.

infra-bot: canary deploy 202 started: h100 pool ok; l40s pool reported 1 unhealthy node (healthcheck failed).

alex: If the canary fails, add an automatic fallback rule: if NaN rate > 0.1% then switch model->int8 for that replica and surface sample inputs that triggered NaNs. Also add KV cache checksum telemetry+counts for evictions.

jia: Will implement telemetry and automated fallback in the rollout job. Opening a small PR with tests and perf logs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
